session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bear Trend from the Open to Trading Range'. A overnight chart: a gap down with bear continuation drives the 3-bar bear micro-channel trend down to a double bottom; a 50% retrace bull trend lifts into a MM bull breakout, makes double tops at 7568, then bear breakout and MM bear breakout into a tight bear channel vacuum selloff into support closing 7552.
